summary: Every pull request and main push now checks and builds source before transferring only a checksummed packed application, smoke driver, and provenance manifest to a fresh consumer job without checkout.

The consumer proves the packaged executable runs from an unrelated directory with fresh production dependencies, serves its own assets, coordinates one SQLite owner across offline and live CLI access, and performs real MCP claim/start/stop/restart/release operations.

Damaged assets, checksum errors, command failures, incomplete claim release, survivor processes, or forced cleanup fail the check while bounded redacted success and failure reports preserve useful evidence.
